sloka: स काले प्राप्तवाँल्लोकमिलो ब्राह्ममनुत्तमम् ।ऐलः पुरूरवा राजा प्रतिष्ठानमवाप्तवान् ।। ७.९०.२३ ॥
transliteration: sa kāle prāptavām̐llokamilo brāhmamanuttamam ।ailaḥ purūravā rājā pratiṣṭhānamavāptavān ।। 7.90.23 ॥

translations.english: In due course, King Ila attained the unsurpassed divine realm of Brahma, and his son, King Pururava Aila, then obtained Pratishthana.
